blocks.raw: Reports play a crucial role in extracting meaningful insights about business performance. With Insights+ you can create these reports for aggregating and analyzing data, providing a comprehensive overview of key metrics, enabling businesses to identify trends, assess marketing strategies' success, and pinpoint improvement areas.
